lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, becoming more compressed toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 4th line from the posterior end, splitting in the upper-third of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 2nd and 5th lines from the posterior terminate mid-flank before reaching the ventral margin; the 8th line appears as a series of three abbreviated dashes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of three high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, arranged in a triangular formation.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a spiral lyrate trajectory, initially diverging at approximately 30 degrees from the vertical axis before curving medially toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.8 times the pixel width of the left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 10-15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white dorsal mane and a dense fringe of dark hair along the ventral midline; orange-tan coloration on the lower extremities (stockings).
